title: FactoryTelemetryV1
description: Canonical normalized equipment telemetry event. Topic: factory.telemetry.v1, key: equipmentId. Produced exclusively by edge-gateway. v0.3: measurement values are nullable (DEC-008), quality flags are a closed enum (GAP-061), and quality.overall is derived, never free-form.

eventId.description: Unique per emitted event. Not a deduplication key; see duplicateIdentity below.

eventTimeUtc.description: When the measurement was taken. OPC UA SourceTimestamp where available; for Modbus this equals ingestTimeUtc and TIMESTAMP_SYNTHESISED is raised.

occurredAtUtc.description: Envelope time. For telemetry this equals eventTimeUtc.

sequence.description: Strictly monotonic per equipmentId, assigned by the EQUIPMENT (not the gateway) so that gateway-side loss is detectable. Resets to 0 only on equipment restart, which must coincide with a sourceEpochMs reset.

producer.description: Producing service identity, e.g. edge-gateway@host-1. Required for causation auditing (NFR-002).

sourceProtocol.description: Which OT protocol this sample was read through. Determines whether eventTimeUtc is authoritative.

overall.description: DERIVED by the edge-gateway from flags and the safety-required sensor map (TIME_AND_DATA_QUALITY.md 6). A contract test asserts this value matches the derivation rule.

flags.description: Closed vocabulary (GAP-061). An unlisted flag is a contract violation.

channel.description: __event__ is used for event-scoped flags such as BUFFER_OVERFLOW_DROP and SEQUENCE_GAP that are not attributable to one channel.

detail.description: Human-readable context. Never used for machine decisions and never used as a metric label.

measurements.description: All seven keys are REQUIRED so the shape is stable. Values are nullable: null means no trustworthy value exists and MUST be accompanied by a quality flag for that channel. Substituting a synthetic, zero, or last-known value is forbidden (DEC-008).

equipmentState.description: Gateway-observed equipment state at sample time.

causationId.description: Null for telemetry: it originates a causation chain rather than continuing one.
